svg.title: Xinoss — About Me
svg.desc: Languages: C++ · C# · JavaScript/TypeScript. Focus: Binary analysis · systems · automation. Mindset: Curious by nature · interest-driven. I’m interested in reverse engineering because I like uncovering how software works beneath the surface. I enjoy investigating program behavior, exploring systems, and building tools based on what I learn. I don't follow a strict roadmap. When something catches my interest, I tend to dig into it until it makes sense—and that's when I enjoy building the most.
